name: Handcrafted Papyrus Scroll
description: Authentic Egyptian papyrus scroll featuring ancient hieroglyphics and traditional artwork. This beautifully preserved scroll showcases classic Egyptian symbols and pharaonic designs, making it a perfect souvenir from the land of the pharaohs.

name: Golden Ankh Pendant
description: Exquisitely crafted golden ankh symbol pendant, representing eternal life in ancient Egyptian culture. This elegant piece features intricate detailing and is made with traditional techniques. The ankh, also known as the key of life, is a powerful symbol of immortality and divine protection.

name: Pyramid Miniature Set
description: Exquisite hand-painted miniature set of the Great Pyramids of Giza. This detailed replica set captures the grandeur of the ancient pyramids with precision. A perfect decorative piece for your home or office that brings the mystique of ancient Egypt to any space.

name: Egyptian Cotton Scarf
description: Luxurious 100% Egyptian cotton scarf with traditional pharaonic patterns and hieroglyphic designs. Soft, elegant, and perfect for any occasion. This premium scarf features authentic Egyptian motifs that celebrate the rich cultural heritage of Egypt.

name: Sphinx Statue Replica
description: Detailed replica of the Great Sphinx of Giza, handcrafted from premium materials. This timeless piece of Egyptian heritage captures the majestic presence of the legendary sphinx. A stunning decorative item that honors one of the world's most iconic monuments.

name: Alabaster Vase
description: Elegant hand-carved alabaster vase with traditional Egyptian motifs and hieroglyphic inscriptions. This beautiful piece showcases the artistry of Egyptian craftsmanship. A sophisticated addition to any collection that reflects the elegance of ancient Egyptian design.
